title: The Marble Race of the Mountain Goats
description: On the first dry morning, the village gathers above the slate track. A mountain goat nudges the red marble into the bend.
alt: A shaggy mountain goat nudges a red glass marble into a winding groove on an alpine ledge. Two goats and a hillside crowd watch at sunrise.
pairing: An alpine village holiday × mountain goats racing glass marbles
